SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT INQ_NO AS QUOTATION_NO FROM IF_CUST_INQ WHERE IF_REC_YN IN ('N','X') AND INQ_STATUS IN ('01','05') GROUP BY INQ_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'NETW' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, CONVERT(CHAR(8),INQ_REQ_DATE,112) AS INQ_REQ_DATE, ISNULL(INQ_NO,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, '00001' AS QUOTATION_SEQ, '01' AS REVISION, 'C' AS STATUS, ISNULL(ITEM_CD,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(ORD_BP_NM,' ') AS ORD_BP_NM, CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(ORD_BP_NM,' ')+'/'+ISNULL(RMK,' ')) AS REMARK, ISNULL(ITEM_NM,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, ISNULL(SPEC,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, ISNULL(MODEL,' ') AS MODEL, ISNULL(MAKER,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, ISNULL(UNIT,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, ISNULL(INQ_QTY, 0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(RMK,' ') AS RMK, ISNULL(CUST_ITEM_CD,' ') AS REF_IF_NO, CONVERT(CHAR(8),ISNULL(PO_DT,GETDATE()),112) AS PO_DT, CONVERT(CHAR(8),ISNULL(DLVY_DATE,GETDATE()+5),112) AS RD_DATE, CONVERT(CHAR(8),ISNULL(DLVY_DATE,GETDATE()+5),112) AS CLOSE_DATE, '160000' AS CLOSE_TIME, ISNULL(DOC_NO,' ') AS HD_REMARK, ISNULL(OUT_CD,' ') AS OUT_CD, ISNULL(CUST_COST_CD,' ') AS CUST_COST_CD, ISNULL(CUST_DEPT_NM,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, ISNULL(CUST_ID,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(REQ_PRC, 0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(FUR_DOC_NO,' ') AS FUR_DOC_NO, ISNULL(RECEIVE_PRC,0) AS RECEIVE_PRC, ISNULL(INQ_STATUS,' ') AS PLANT, ISNULL(INQ_RMK_HSN,' ') AS INQ_RMK_HSN, ISNULL(INQ_RMK_BP,' ') AS INQ_RMK_BP, ISNULL(' ',' ') AS SUPP_ITEM_CD, ISNULL(' ',' ') AS CUST_ADDR, ISNULL(' ',' ') AS CUST_ZIP_CD, ISNULL(IF_REC_YN ,' ') AS IF_REC_YN FROM IF_CUST_INQ WHERE IF_REC_YN IN ('N','X') AND INQ_STATUS IN ('01','05') AND INQ_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' ORDER BY INQ_NO
UPDATE IF_CUST_INQ SET IF_REC_YN = 'Y' WHERE IF_REC_YN IN ('N','X') AND INQ_STATUS IN ('01','05') AND INQ_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$'
